design_specification: Steel, slate and bronze on white; color, line style and shape identify series.
interpolation: Linear in CIELab; gamut and lightness monotonicity checked in figure_style.py

semantics.categorical: A cold lightness ladder identifies series: deep steel blue (L*31) for the research signal, slate (L*40) for measured attention, mid steel grey (L*51) for secondary series and light cool grey (L*62) for references, always with marker and line-style redundancy. Series colours do not encode numerical sign.
semantics.sequential: White to deep steel blue encodes nonnegative magnitude (L* 100 to 37). Figure 2a retains 0 to 0.8 percentage points.
semantics.diverging: Steel blue is negative, white is zero, and muted bronze is positive; both ends have L* 44 and C* about 15, so neither direction is emphasised; comparable panels share the stated zero-centred limits.
semantics.missing: Unsupported and unestimated cells retain their explicit markers, status labels or compact status tables and are not treated as zero.
semantics.grayscale: Shape and line-style distinctions are retained. Diverging lightness is symmetric, so grayscale lightness alone cannot identify sign (notably S9); consult the signed-value source table.
semantics.timing: The three timing variants use a single cold family, with repeated dashed/dash-dot/solid lines and circle/square/triangle markers. The full fixed configuration and complete 48-run grid remain visible.
